record.one_liner: Firecrawl is an API and toolset for web searching, scraping, crawling, and interacting with live web content to return clean markdown, structured data, or AI agent context.

auth_methods.quote: No account or API key is required for this request. cURL # No API key needed to get started — add -H "Authorization: Bearer $FIRECRAWL_API_KEY" for higher rate limits

access_test.quote: Create a free account for direct API access and higher limits

access_ship.quote: Firecrawl Keyless gives you 1,000 free credits a month with no API key or signup across MCP, the CLI and the API.

api_breadth.quote: Search Search the web and get full page content from results Scrape Extract content from any URL as markdown, HTML, or structured JSON Interact Continue working with any scraped page: click, fill forms, extract dynamic content

official_mcp.quote: MCP Server : Connect Firecrawl to any AI tool via the Model Context Protocol .
